summary: AI Era Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a $51,500 convertible promissory note issuance to Lambda Ventures, LLC, with a $5,000 legal fee deduction and $1,500 original issue discount. The note carries 10% interest, matures in 12 months, and is convertible at 80% of the lowest 20-day trading price. Proceeds fund SaaS AI build-out. This is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation.
